rows.text: Increments the word at `+0x46` of the object at `rcx+0x38` and returns when it is at most 0xC8 (unsigned `jbe`); otherwise, with the state record at `rcx+0x30`, it takes a location string (`01CCCFD8` when the dword `+0x68` of the record's first-qword object is zero, else `0081BFF0` formatting `01CCCFE8` with that dword), formats `01CCD000` with `01CCD068`, 0xC8 and that string through `0081BFF0` (both formats on the qword `+0x38` of the record's `+0x18` object), and passes the result with the record's `+0x18` qword to `00824330`, where the listed range ends.
